requirement: The card of an own domain that starts with www. says to forward the bare name to it at the DNS provider

oracle.ref: PR #1032 (fix); fix evidence: A site connects a subdomain only and nothing forwards the bare domain, so `example.com` opened nothing while `www.example.com` was live, and the screen did not say so.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'. S2: the case is 'ok': the card of `www.example.com` draws the line `bare-name` with `example.com` and `www.example.com`; the card of `shop.example.com` has no such line.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a domain that starts with www. says how its bare name reaches the site; any other subdomain says nothing
tests: a domain that starts with www. says how its bare name reaches the site; any other subdomain says nothing
